title: Leak Isolation Standard Work
content: For suspected leaks, validate pressure anomaly with upstream and downstream sensors, isolate the affected segment, notify dispatch, and confirm restoration before reopening valves.

title: Pump and Valve Response Guide
content: When pressure drops below the dynamic threshold and flow increases unexpectedly, reduce pump speed by 10 percent, verify valve telemetry, and issue a field inspection work order.

title: Incident A12 Retrospective
content: High confidence leak event near node N-21 was mitigated in 42 minutes after dispatch. Customer notification reduced repeat complaint volume by 28 percent.
